text: A Brand Kit is the resolvable design system a scene references through $tokens. Lumen designs look on-brand because they reference role tokens, not because the model guessed nice values.
note: Frames "on-brand" as using tokens; the brand's visual look (imagery, material, mood) is not part of the kit's definition.

text: If a scene contains token references, preflight must receive an effective Brand Kit … Avoid ambiguous tokenized forms with no precise carrier — prefer a full style($type.headline).
Approved kits are stricter than draft/generated ones. When strict governance flags raw styling, repair by choosing a semantic token — never swap one arbitrary value for another.
note: References logo-and-assets.md — legacy-only, not in the scene view (BROKEN REFERENCE).

text: Generation turns structured seed inputs into a draft kit … generate_brand_kit(seed) -> BrandGenerationReport … Generated kits start generated_unreviewed — do not claim they are approved.
note: The scene agent has no kit-generation tool.

text: Agent behavior when the user has no kit: 1. prefer the platform default for a neutral demo brand; 2. generate a draft kit when the user gives enough brand signals; 3. ask for missing brand facts only when the task can't proceed safely; 4. keep token names semantic.
note: Step 2 is impossible for the scene agent.

text: Use Brand Kit semantic tokens before raw values … surface.*, text.*, border.*, type.*, space.*, radius.*, opacity.*, logo.*, asset.* … agents should prefer role tokens unless a repair explicitly asks for a low-level token.
Product-ready minimum token list … If a needed token is missing, ask for Brand Kit validation or generation. Do not silently invent a raw replacement.
note: Conflicts with brand-and-tokens (D12): "record the kit gap or use an appropriate independently layered image"; the scene agent cannot request validation/generation.

text: Scene governance strict mode flags raw fills/strokes/typography/spacing, logo on disallowed backgrounds, print transparency (LUMB0804–0815).
Do not repair off-brand output by picking a new raw hex value unless the user explicitly asks for an override.

DSL should not hard-code mode-specific values. Use semantic tokens and let preflight resolve the active mode … Treat mode compatibility diagnostics as product safety issues, not as visual preferences.
